slides: Your muscles don’t remember reps, they remember tension.
Each set is a signal: lift heavier, they adapt.
But adaptation stalls when the signal fades.
Add a few extra pounds or a pause, and the growth resumes.
Consistency + incremental overload = unstoppable strength.
Decision fatigue is the silent thief of ambition.
Every trivial choice drains a slice of willpower.
When your brain is exhausted, default = comfort.
Pre‑plan your core actions, automate the rest.
Guard your willpower; reserve it for what truly matters.
Training is the loudest part; recovery is the quiet teacher.
During deep sleep, growth hormone floods the bloodstream.
Skipping sleep is like training on an empty tank.
Even 30 minutes of REM can reset hormone balance.
Prioritize sleep, and your workouts will thank you.
Big goals are just a chain of tiny habits.
If you miss one link, the chain weakens.
Write the next micro‑action before you finish the current.
Link them together; momentum builds automatically.
Your future self is built one 5‑minute habit at a time.
